title: The Chess Game Nears Its End
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji uttered that answer which made the Eye of Heavenly Secrets tremble, the rules of the entire Forbidden Grounds began to collapse—and the fragment in his hand was completing itself at an incredible, frantic speed.

text.content: In the Void, a figure slowly coalesced. It was not a physical body, but an consciousness projection woven from countless profound runes—Cang Yutian, or rather, the concrete manifestation of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Chen Ji felt his breath completely cease at this moment. That pressure was not merely physical force, but a deeper existential oppression, as if the entire universe's operating principles were gazing upon him, wishing to lay bare all his secrets, all his schemes, before this gaze.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The voice did not emerge from the projection but exploded directly within Chen Ji's consciousness, like thunder from the Nine Heavens, "Through ten thousand years of ups and downs, you are the most interesting piece I have ever seen."

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the trembling of his soul, yet his face remained the usual timid appearance, even instinctively stepping back half a pace. His gaze dared not meet the projection, slightly lowered, just like atrash Outer Disciple/Servant terrified by a strong cultivator's momentum. But deep within his consciousness, the Tianji Record Fragment was trembling violently, as if sensing something Chen Ji deliberately concealed—rage, boundless rage.

dialogue.content: "No need to pretend." Cang Yutian's projection slightly leaned forward, and a hint of playful smile appeared on that rune-woven face, "From the moment I chose you, every step of your chess, every instance of restraint, every time you played the fool to devour the tiger—all have been under my watch."

text.content: These words were like a bucket of ice water poured over his head. Chen Ji's fingers trembled almost imperceptibly, then he tucked them into his sleeve. He slowly raised his head, for the first time directly facing that projection, and the timidity in his pupils was fading at an incredible speed, replaced by an icy chill.

dialogue.content: "Chosen?" Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet terrifyingly clear, "I would like to hear the details."

"Do you know where this ancient chess game comes from?" Cang Yutian's projection lightly waved his hand, and countless light points appeared in the Void, each light point a humanoid silhouette, "The Universe's Will needs a vessel. In this current era, as dimensions shift and Heavenly Secrets crumble is imminent, I need a perfect container—someone who can bear the Universe's Will and continue the operation of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: Among those humanoid silhouettes in the light points, Chen Ji recognized a few—ancient prophets who fell, supreme experts from primordial times who perished, though more were faces he had never seen. They were tragic, resentful, or confused, all frozen in the Void in the same posture—dead, or rather, devoured.

dialogue.content: "And you, Chen Ji—" Cang Yutian's voice suddenly rose, "are the final candidate I meticulously selected through countless ages. Your bloodline, your spiritual roots, that sealed primordial will deep in your soul—all are gifts I bestowed upon you. The incompleteness of the Tianji Record is not a flaw, but a screening tool. Only those who can constantly grow, constantly scheme, constantly break through despite this incompleteness deserve to stand before me."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart tightly gripped by an invisible hand. The Tianji Record was a screening tool? All his serendipity, all his growth, all his calculations—were they all on the opponent's chessboard? Rage surged like a tide, yet was forcibly suppressed by his reason. On his face even appeared a bitter smile, that smile perfectly displaying the despair of a piece toyed with by fate.

However, just then, an intense fluctuation came from deep within his consciousness. That dormant primordial will, upon hearing Cang Yutian's words, began to frantically stir. An ancient and violent force churned in Chen Ji's bloodline, seeming to break through some kind of confinement, letting out angry howls.

choice.prompt: Faced with the revelation of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' truth, how will Chen Ji choose to respond to this information sufficient to overturn his understanding?

choices.text: Forcefully maintain composure, continue to probe
choices.description: Suppress the surging shock in his heart, continue to appear weak under thetrash persona, attempt to extract more information about the chess game from Cang Yutian.
choices.visible_cost: Consume energy to maintain the disguise
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may have seen through all disguises

dialogue.content: "Senior... what Senior said, the小的 truly cannot comprehend." Chen Ji's voice slightly trembled, his eye sockets even reddening, "The小的 is merely an Outer Disciple/Servant of the Tianqing Sect, how could I become... what container?"

text.content: He hung his head, putting on a terrified appearance, yet his consciousness was as sharp as a hawk's, catching every fluctuation of Cang Yutian's projection. In the art of acting, this Chen Ji, from entering the sect until now, has never lost.

choices.text: Tear apart the disguise, confront directly
choices.description: Since the opponent already knows everything, continuing to disguise is merely self-deception. Chen Ji might as well reveal his true edge, engaging the Eye of Heavenly Secrets in direct confrontation.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing true strength may incur greater threats
choices.visible_reward: Win Cang Yutian's true attention and respect
choices.risk_hint: Revealing too early might alert the quarry.

dialogue.content: "Enough." Chen Ji's voice turned abruptly cold, the timidity dissipating like thin fog blown away by wind, revealing the bone-deep chill beneath. He slowly raised his head, his eyes blazing with fierce light—nowhere to be seen was even a trace of thetrash. "An eternal chess game? A selection tool? Cang Yutian, you think far too highly of yourself, and far too little of Chen Ji."

text.content: He stepped forward, actually taking the initiative to approach the projection. Within his consciousness, the Tianji Record Fragment's trembling grew increasingly intense, and the roar of that ancient will grew clearer—as if responding to Chen Ji's current battle intent.

choices.text: Communicating with the Ancient Will through Consciousness
choices.description: Temporarily not responding to Cang Yutian, but turning attention to the restless ancient will deep within his consciousness, trying to understand why it awakened at this moment.
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining Key Information from the Ancient Will
choices.risk_hint: The Ancient Will May Not Be Trustworthy

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, instead pouring all his consciousness into the restless seal within his body. In an instant, an ancient and violent will flooded into his mind—a roar from antiquity: "I am... the First Keeper of the Tianji Record... Cang Yutian... he deceived everyone..."

Before the words even finished, Cang Yutian's projection suddenly drew close, those rune-woven eyes fixed intently on Chen Ji, as if wanting to pierce through his soul: "With whom are you conversing?"

dialogue.content: "Enough." Cang Yutian's projection seemed indifferent to any of Chen Ji's reactions, "You and I both know, the act has reached this point with no more meaning. Now, I give you a choice—"

text.content: A scene materialized in the void. There was the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, Su Qingyao secluded in meditation; there was the dungeon of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, Chen Nian's emaciated form bound by chains; there was the Xuanwu Sect Martial Arena, Han Lie sparring with a group of disciples... Every person Chen Ji cared for was fully exposed in the casually sketched scene by Cang Yutian.

dialogue.content: "Voluntarily become the vessel, to carry the universe's will." Cang Yutian's voice sounded like Heaven's judgment, "Your soul will merge with the Heavenly Dao, your body will become the foundation maintaining the operation of all realms. And those you cherish—Su Qingyao, Chen Nian, Ye Qing, even Han Lie whom you defeated—all may live safely."

"This is mercy." Cang Yutian's projection slightly bowed, a trace of compassion appearing on the rune-woven face, "After all, if you resist, I can simply find another vessel. It's just those people... not one will be spared."

text.content: Chen Ji's fist slowly tightened. Countless images flashed through his mind—Su Qingyao glancing back at him while practicing sword beneath the moon, Chen Nian's childish voice as a child tugging at his robe calling "brother," Ye Qing's trusting smile appearing through the demonic mist... These people were the sole bonds from his rebirth in this life. And now, Cang Yutian demanded he trade everything for their lives.

"Accept his offer." A voice suddenly rang out in Chen Ji's consciousness, that of Mo Xiansheng—the remnant soul guardian, "This is the most prudent choice. You lose only yourself, while they... at least get to live."

choice.prompt: Facing the ultimate bargain proposed by the Eye of Heavenly Dao—trading his own body for everyone's safety, how will Chen Ji decide?

choices.description: For Su Qingyao, Chen Nian, Ye Qing, and all those he cares for, Chen Ji decides to sacrifice himself, ensuring their safety. This was the final tenderness he could offer.
choices.visible_cost: Losing Oneself, Consciousness Will Merge with the Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: All Cherished Ones Safe and Sound
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's Suggestion May Not Be Trustworthy

dialogue.content: "...Alright." Chen Ji's voice was very soft, as light as a feather falling into the abyss. He slowly closed his eyes, even a trace of relieved smile appearing at the corners of his mouth, "I accept your proposal."

text.content: Yet the moment his words fell, a howl of ancient, violent fury erupted from the depths of his consciousness—"No!!!" The ancient will seemed utterly enraged, an unprecedented power like a flood bursting through Chen Ji's seal, surging directly into his limbs and meridians.

choices.description: Chen Ji is no pawn to be manipulated, even if his opponent is Heaven itself. He'd rather be shattered into pieces than become someone else's vessel. This is his dignity as a chess player.
choices.visible_cost: Those he cares about will face danger
choices.visible_reward: Maintain oneself, preserve the possibility of a comeback
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian." Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, his eyes blazing with sharp light. "Who do you think you are?" He stepped forward, his aura rising sharply. "My fate has always been in my own hands."

text.content: "You want to be the chess player?" Chen Ji sneered, his smile carrying undisguised mockery. "Have you ever wondered—why I, knowing I was a pawn, still came this far today?"

choices.description: The information revealed by the ancient will made Chen Ji realize Cang Yutian was not invincible. He would use the trump card unknown to his opponent to directly pierce this so-called "ultimate choice."
choices.risk_hint: The ancient will's words may not all be trustworthy

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian, or rather—" Chen Ji's voice turned cold. "The original master of the Tianji Record?" He gazed at the shifting rune light of that projection, a mocking curve forming at his lips. "You think I don't know? Your so-called 'Eye of Heavenly Dao' is nothing but the counterforce born from stealing the Tianji Record's primordial power. You are no cosmic will—you are a thief!"

text.content: Cang Yutian's projection trembled violently, the symbol-woven face contorting into an indescribable rage. Chen Ji knew he had gambled correctly. Within the ancient will's transmitted information lay a crucial point—Cang Yutian was not Heavenly Dao itself, but the former master of the Tianji Record who, in some prophecy, glimpsed forbidden secrets, thus being counteracted by the Tianji Record's primordial power, transforming into its current monstrous form.

The ancient will's power surged like a breached flood, careening wildly through Chen Ji's meridians. That withered ancient consciousness was silent no more, fusing with Chen Ji's soul in an almost manic fervor. Fragments of broken memories flooded his mind—the perspective of the original Tianji Record master, a tale of betrayal, greed, and destruction.

dialogue.content: "Silence!" Cang Yutian's projection suddenly expanded, an apocalyptic pressure pouring down. "You understand nothing!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt his soul wavering under this pressure, but he did not retreat. The ancient will's power was perfectly merging with his soul, an unprecedented strength awakening within him. He slowly raised his head, directly facing that raging projection, a cold smile curling at his lips.

dialogue.content: "I understand perfectly." Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly echoed through this void. "You were once a master too, yet you betrayed the Tianji Record's essence for eternity. What you need is not a vessel—you need a new shell to perpetuate your rotting existence!"

text.content: Cang Yutian's projection solidified completely. Those symbol-woven features contorted into a nearly grotesque form, the once lofty majesty vanished in an instant. After a long while, a low laugh emerged from the projection, carrying几分crazed，几分自嘲 madness and self-mockery.

dialogue.content: "Good...good...very good!" Cang Yutian repeated the word three times, his laughter growing increasingly manic. "Worthy of being my chosen chess piece—you have not disappointed me!" The projection surged逼近， forward aggressively, symbol-woven eyes burning with frantic flames. "Since you know the truth, you must be eliminated—your existence has already threatened my chess game!"

choice.prompt: After the truth was exposed, Cang Yutian completely discarded his mask and decided to directly erase Chen Ji. At this life-and-death moment, how does Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: The ancient will's power was awakening, Chen Ji decided to risk everything, fighting Cang Yutian to the death in these forbidden grounds. Even if shattered to pieces, he would make the other pay the price.

dialogue.content: "Want to kill me?" Chen Ji laughed skyward, that laughter carrying unyielding battle intent. "Cang Yutian, you underestimate Chen Ji far too much!" The Tianji Record Fragment blazed with unprecedented light in his consciousness, that ancient will transforming into a stream of light that merged into the fragment.

text.content: In an instant, the entire Forbidden Grounds trembled under this force's impact. Chen Ji's aura escalated geometrically. Though still inferior to Cang Yutian, it was no longer a comparison between ant and divine dragon.

choices.description: Cang Yutian had been enraged, the Forbidden Grounds about to become a battlefield of final reckoning. Chen Ji decided to temporarily retreat, using the Forbidden Grounds' rules and the enemy's weaknesses to reorganize.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity to severely wound the opponent

text.content: Chen Ji did not linger in battle. In the instant Cang Yutian erupted in fury, he activated the spatial laws sealed within the Tianji Record Fragment. A minute crack split open in the void—that was the loophole in the Forbidden Grounds' rules, the escape route he had long calculated.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian." Chen Ji's voice emerged from that crack, carrying a hint of mockery. "The chess game nears its end—but the outcome is not for you to decide."

choices.description: The ancient will resonated with the Tianji Record Fragment. In this moment, Chen Ji truly awakened the Tianji Record's full power. He would make Cang Yutian understand who was the true Chess Player in this eternal chess game.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain core ability to oppose Cang Yutian

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment blazed with blinding golden light at this moment. The originally incomplete pages began to perfect at a visible rate. The ancient will transformed into a stream of light flooding into the fragment, completely merging with Chen Ji's soul. In an instant, Chen Ji felt he had touched some kind of origin—that was the Tianji Record's original form, the Heavenly Dao supreme principle before Cang Yutian stole it.
"This... is impossible!" Cang Yutian's projection trembled violently. Those eyes woven from runes actually showed a flicker of fear. "How could you touch the origin—I clearly already..."

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, Cang Yutian's response was singular. The runes in the void began to madly rotate, the entire Forbidden Grounds' rules violently trembling under that force's pull. Cang Yutian's projection no longer maintained human form but transformed into a giant eye woven from countless profound runes—the true form of the Heavenly Dao Eye.

dialogue.content: "Since you already know the truth, you must be eliminated even more." The Heavenly Dao Eye's voice was like Heavenly Dao's judgment. "Since the Eternal Chess Game began, all variables have been under my control—except you." That giant eye slowly turned, its invisible gaze pressing upon Chen Ji like something tangible. "You are my only loophole, my only threat."

text.content: Chen Ji felt the destruction intent contained within that gaze. Cang Yutian was serious—he truly intended to end everything here. The Forbidden Grounds' rules began to崩解, spatial cracks spreading like spiderwebs. Chen Ji knew, regardless of his choice, this battle had become unavoidable.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian." Chen Ji's voice was very calm, nearly cold calm. "You think you control everything, but you don't know—I was never your chess piece." He slowly raised his hand. The Tianji Record Fragment floated above his palm, radiating light utterly different from the Heavenly Dao Eye. "From the moment you handed me the fragment, the chess game had already changed."

text.content: The Forbidden Grounds' tremors grew increasingly violent. A strange standoff formed between the Heavenly Dao Eye and the Tianji Record Fragment. Two utterly different forces collided in the void, stirring countless ripples of rule fragments. Chen Ji knew the final battle was approaching, and he—had already made all preparations. The Eternal Chess Game, its final move about to begin.
